posts.name: Theta_Sigma
posts.cooked:
Get a bunch of Sentinels and animation geeks together and get them to make a list. The results are entertaining.

Here is our list. There are a lot of casting jokes in there, and I hope you find it as fun as we did!

Heroes

  • Legacy - Brian Bloom
  • Tachyon -Vanessa Marshall
  • The Wraith - Melissa Gilbert
  • Bunker - Troy Baker
  • Absolute Zero - Jeff Bennett*
  • Haka - Jay Laga'aia
  • Fanatic - Maria Canals-Barrera
  • Ra - David Kaye
  • Tempest - Jason Marsden
  • The Visionary - Summer Glau
  • Mr Fixer - Sab Shimono
  • Expatriette - Claudia Black
  • NightMist - Kelly Hu
  • The Argent Adept - Neil Patrick Harris
  • Chrono-Ranger - Adam Baldwin
  • Omnitron-X - Jason Spisak
  • The Scholar - Stephen Fry
  • Unity - Kari Wahlgren
  • K.N.Y.F.E - Jennifer Hale
  • Mainstay - Paul Eiding
  • Dr Medico - Alan Tudyk
  • The  Idealist - Kristen Schaal
  • Writhe - Wally Wingert
  • The Naturalist - James C. Mathis
  • Setback - Josh Keaton
  • Parse - Cree Summer
  • Beacon - Janet Varney
  • Captain Cosmic - Deidrich Bader
  • Sky-Scraper - Colleen O'Shaughnessey
  • Guise - Christopher Badell
 
Villains
  • Baron Blade - Liam O'Brien
  • Citizen Dawn - Susan Sarandon
  • Voss - Michael Ironside
  • Omnitron - Frank Welker
  • Plague Rat - Mark Hamill
  • Spite - John DiMaggio
  • The Chairman - Jonathan Frakes
  • The Operative - Sumalee Montano
  • The Matriarch - Tara Strong
  • Akash-Bhuta
  • Apostate - Ron Perlman
  • GloomWeaver - Jeffrey Combs
  • Iron Legacy - Roger Craig Smith
  • Kismet - Grey DeLisle
  • La Capitan - Gina Torres
  • The Dreamer - Summer Glau
  • Ambuscade - Georges St-Pierre
  • Miss Information - Arleen Sorkin
  • Fright Train - Kevin Michael Richardson
  • Friction - Lauren Tom
  • Ermine  - Diane Pershing
  • Proletariat - Jim Cummings
  • Wager Master - Alex Hirsch
 
*It was discussed that Michael Ansara, who voiced the Batman: The Animated Series version of Mr Freeze (the version that introduced his now mainstream accepted origin) would be an excellent choice for Absolute Zero. However, Mr Ansara passed away last year.

Will Farrell and Jim Carrey are outstanding at playing the one-dimensional comic character, but when you try to make that character carry a movie it doesn't work.

The Truman Show (which I don't like at all) was really well acted by Carrey, and it wasn't a sketch comedy character turned into a leading role.  Most of Will Farrell, Adam Sandler and Jim Carrey's films are a sketch stretched out into a movie, and those suck.
